items.title: Animator Breaks NDA to Leak Anime Early aka Grand Blue Season 2
items.description:
From a well known and trusted leaker revealed that "Grand Blue Season 2 is Currently in Development". As for how the leaker got the info... we can assume its from CN Outsourcing.

Its been 6 years since Grand Blue aired in 2018 and now we finally got new information.

Original Leak Thread: https://t

items.title: Entire Anime Season got Leaked..
items.description:
We have waited 7 years since 2018 to see Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 in 2025, but some jerk decided to leak the entire Season 2 of Grand Blue late last night. With the massive security leak by supposed Japanese Company. It was revealed on the final episode of S2 that Season 3 is in Production.

#gr
